description: Defines utilities for JSON-RPC direct linking, including security token retrieval and a class for managing JSON-RPC calls over a dispatcher.

classes.name: JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: Manages JSON-RPC communication with a remote controller, including serialization/deserialization and invoking remote methods.

methods.name: GetThunderSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token from the security agent via the provided service interface.

methods.name: JSONRPCDirectLink::Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a remote JSON-RPC method with specified parameters and processes the response.

methods.name: GetThunderControllerClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a JSONRPCDirectLink instance, managing security token acquisition.
